scientific_integrity: Unrestricted proof uses local part rules, mixed-part persistence, exact combinatorial counting, and a decreasing two-time energy. Direct finite and weighted-profile checks are separately reproducible; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-sized parts and strict synchronous binary open-neighbor majority with tie retention only. Neither transient basin sizes nor their entrance times are counted. Historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Activity-resolved majority two-cycles on equal-part Turán graphs
